messages:
lena: Heads-up — large fintech customer asked for: 1) per-tenant audit log retention buckets, 2) BYOK with key rotation window guarantees, and 3) SOC2 evidence export that’s queryable for 7yrs. Asking product for launch criteria + prioritization. Any immediate blockers?
ria: Thanks — is the 7yr ask legal-mandated or negotiable?
jordan: Legal: for specific markets yes, 7yrs is sometimes required. But we can offer tiered SLAs (3y default, 7y premium). Need custody/chain-of-custody language.
lena: Good — thinking tiered retention feature: standard (90d), extended (3y), archive (7y). Archive requires Dedicated/Private + BYOK. Thoughts?
tom: From infra POV: archive 7y has storage + index costs. Queryable 7y means we need cold+warm tiers and searchable indexes (more infra ops). Need a rough cost estimate before committing.
kyle: Ops: also need clarity on retention purge triggers, export tooling, and legal-hold toggles. We should define an immutable evidence export format (WARC/JSONL) and retention metadata.
lena: Draft launch criteria suggestion: 1) retention tiers implemented end-to-end (UI/API), 2) BYOK integration with rotation grace period <= 48h, 3) export format + audit-proof checksum, 4) SOC2 evidence path documented + e2e test for one customer. If any of these require >2 sprint infra work, move to beta.
jordan: Agree on criteria. Add: Key escrow/escrow + access log for key unwraps. Also require KMS audit logs surfaced to customer.
ria: Security note — BYOK rotation grace window: we must ensure decryptability for outstanding tokens/requests; propose KV cache tombstone policy + fallback decrypt path to avoid data loss. This impacts runtime changes.
tom: Technical constraint: current runtime assumes model-serving keys are ephemeral; adding BYOK for persisted audit blobs will need new envelope encryption flow. Estimate: 1.5 dev sprints + 1 infra sprint for CI/CD and testing.
lena: Ok. Prioritization: customers paying >$X or committed to Dedicated get archive+BYOK; GA for hosted customers is standard + extended only. Proposed phasing: MVP (standard + extended exports, 3y), Phase 2 (BYOK envelope + archive), Phase 3 (7y query optimizations).
kyle: Ops checklist item: add legal-hold toggle that prevents purge and logs holds with user/timestamp. Also we need an export job that can do incremental exports for long-retention accounts.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: retention-service-proto v0.3 -> staging at 2025-11-18T09:00Z :rocket:
lena: Example API snippet for retention policy (proto):
```
POST /v1/tenants/{id}/retention
body: {
  "tier": "archive",
  "retention_days": 2555, // ~7yrs
  "byok_key_id": "projects/.../keys/abc",
  "legal_hold": false
}
```
ria: Also add acceptance test: simulate key rotation and validate exported artifacts decrypt.
tom: Agree. For rollout gating: must pass CI decryption test + infra cost signoff. If we hit >$Y/mo for archive index, require pricing addendum.
lena: Action items: 1) tom + kyle to produce cost/ops estimates (due EOD Thu), 2) ria + tom to spec envelope encryption and rotation policy (draft PR by Mon), 3) jordan to draft legal language for SLA/escrow (EOW), 4) product to write launch criteria doc and rollout phasing (I’ll own).
jordan: Sounds good. Also capture edge case: customer requests export retention but then requests deletion — legal hold overrides deletion.
kyle: Noted. I’ll add a runbook for hold disputes + audit trail retention.
lena: If anyone has objections to phasing, speak now. Otherwise I’ll convert this thread into a project ticket and assign owners. :+1:
ria: No objections. We should flag this for security review before public docs.
tom: No objections. Will queue the infra spike.
ops-bot: Ticket created: PROJ-4123 Retention tiers + BYOK archival flow (assigned: lena, tom, ria, kyle)
